purpose: Track catalogued page-level graffiti lettering sources and explicit next inspection actions. This file is not a glyph specimen dataset.

evidence_policy.rule: A record may enter glyph_observation_candidate only after direct inspection of a legible individual glyph. Catalogue metadata or collection descriptions never count as visual inspection.
evidence_policy.rights: Link-only by default. No third-party image is copied or traced. Copyright and reuse permission are tracked separately from access.

source_records.title: Rijksmuseum — Blackbook I
source_records.creator: Boris Tellegen (DELTA)
source_records.rights_status: Copyright Boris Tellegen; viewing does not grant reproduction permission
source_records.evidence: Museum record identifies the book, maker, date range, materials and related individual page records.
source_records.next_action: Inspect related page images individually; isolate repeated glyphs only where the image supports reliable contour reading.

source_records.title: Full Time Artists — Ink Outlines
source_records.creator: Multiple writers; attribution varies by page
source_records.rights_status: All content copyright FTA/original authors; link-only
source_records.evidence: FTA describes monochrome ink works from sketchbooks, made with Rapidograph/inkers, markers and ballpoints; some were blueprints for full-scale pieces.
source_records.next_action: Capture stable individual page URLs and artist credits; prioritize clean contours and multi-letter words with repeated forms.

source_records.title: Full Time Artists — Blackbook Sketches
source_records.creator: FTA members and invited writers
source_records.rights_status: All content copyright FTA/original authors; link-only
source_records.evidence: FTA describes original sketchbook works by crew members and writers from San Jose, San Francisco and elsewhere.
source_records.next_action: Record page-level authorship and media; use as comparison against monochrome outlines, not as an undifferentiated style pool.

source_records.title: Dutch Graffiti Library — Blackbooks
source_records.creator: Multiple writers
source_records.rights_status: Institutional collection; image reuse terms must be checked per object
source_records.evidence: The collection page names individual books and date ranges, and describes blackbooks as spaces for both owners' sketches and invited writers' contributions.
source_records.next_action: Obtain page-level records and attribute each contribution to its writer where possible; do not assume every page is by the book owner.

source_records.title: Dutch Graffiti Library — Eras
source_records.creator: Multiple writers; exact contributors to be established
source_records.confidence: medium; page content not exposed in text capture
source_records.evidence: Collection catalogue describes this book as containing tags, throw-ups and pieces.
source_records.next_action: Visually inspect individual pages and identify credited contributors before creating observations.

page_records.title: Bladzijde 6 uit Black Book I
page_records.creator: Boris Tellegen (DELTA)
page_records.catalogue_description: Three pieces by Delta; pencil on paper; 297 × 205 mm.
page_records.reason: Multiple pieces on one page may provide repeated letter structures and construction comparisons.
page_records.next_action: Open high-resolution page image, segment each of the three pieces, then assess individual legible glyphs.

page_records.title: Bladzijde 7 uit Black Book I
page_records.creator: Boris Tellegen (DELTA)
page_records.catalogue_description: Two colour photographs and one design drawing by Delta; pencil and photographic material; 297 × 205 mm.
page_records.reason: Potential drawing-to-photograph relationship can help distinguish sketch construction from finished rendering.
page_records.next_action: Inspect the design drawing separately from both photographs; do not presume they depict the same piece.

page_records.title: Bladzijde 28 uit Black Book I
page_records.creator: Boris Tellegen (DELTA)
page_records.catalogue_description: Pencil drawing of a seated man with the letters DELTA on the belt buckle.
page_records.reason: The catalogue description identifies lettering, but only as a small belt-buckle detail; likely contextual rather than a useful letterform specimen.
page_records.next_action: Inspect only if the image is legible enough to support a small-scale lettering note.
